description: The Secret of Secrets: A Novel (Robert Langdon)
author: Dan Brown
summary: Robert Langdon, esteemed professor of symbology, travels to Prague to attend a groundbreaking lecture by Katherine Solomon—a prominent noetic scientist with whom he has recently begun a relationship. Katherine is on the verge of publishing an explosive book that contains startling discoveries about the nature of human consciousness and threatens to disrupt centuries of established belief. But a brutal murder catapults the trip into chaos, and Katherine suddenly disappears along with her manuscript. Langdon finds himself targeted by a powerful organization and hunted by a chilling assailant sprung from Prague’s most ancient mythology. As the plot expands into London and New York, Langdon desperately searches for Katherine . . . and for answers. In a thrilling race through the dual worlds of futuristic science and mystical lore, he uncovers a shocking truth about a secret project that will forever change the way we think about the human mind.

author: John Grisham
summary: The Widow (2025) by John Grisham is a legal thriller featuring Simon Latch, a struggling, debt-ridden small-town Virginia lawyer. When 85-year-old widow Eleanor Barnett seeks help with her will, revealing a secret fortune, Simon is drawn into a high-stakes, dangerous game. Following her suspicious death after a car accident, circumstantial evidence makes him the prime suspect in a murder investigation.

author: Ken Follett
summary: Circle of Days (2025) by Ken Follett is a historical novel detailing the construction of Stonehenge around 2500 BCE. The story follows Seft, a creative flint miner, and Joia, a visionary priestess, who unite warring Neolithic tribes (herders, farmers, and woodlanders) to build a massive stone monument amid drought, violence, and social upheaval.

author: Blake Crouch
summary: Recursion by Blake Crouch is a sci-fi thriller following NYPD detective Barry Sutton and neuroscientist Helena Smith as they combat -False Memory Syndrome,- a phenomenon causing people to die from remembering lives they never lived. Helena invents technology to map memories, which is weaponized for time travel, forcing them to unravel a complex, repeating timeline to save reality.

author: Blake Crouch
summary: Dark Matter by Blake Crouch is a fast-paced sci-fi thriller about Jason Dessen, a physics professor kidnapped and thrust into an alternate version of his life. He traverses the multiverse to return to his true family, battling a version of himself that made different choices. It explores themes of regret, the choices that define us, and the nature of reality.

author: Jeremy Robinson
summary: Infinite by Jeremy Robinson is a sci-fi thriller following William Chanokh, who wakes from cryo-sleep on the spaceship Galahad to find his crew murdered by a colleague. After being killed himself, William discovers he is immortal and trapped on a journey with a dangerous AI, leading to a desperate, existential journey through space.
